reproduction_assumptions: This transient-ROM configuration is an explicit non-formal raw-power extension and must not be cited as the paper's steady Eq. (13) result.
McPAT dynamic and leakage powers are used without post-processing multipliers.
Cache delay, area, and aspect-ratio-preserving geometry come only from the local CACTI run.
The accepted ROM identity fixes the workload power trace, module geometry, thermal stack, cooling, grid, HotSpot binary, configuration, and allowed L2 tiers.
Final reported bips2_trans requires both real-HotSpot periodic validation and a current-layout R2 run.
